results.title: Americans voted against Trump's Iran war. Gulf countries hope that means an end to the conflict
results.content: The US midterm results showed how unpopular Donald Trump's Iran war is. Now, Gulf countries, trapped for months in the middle of the war between the US and Iran, see reason for optimism.

results.title: Arrests and investigations as Serbia begins post-election clean-up
results.content: The landslide victory of the Students' List in Serbia's general election seems to have removed a blockage in the justice system: Cases that were long stalled are now suddenly moving forward.

results.title: Iran signals satisfaction, skepticism after US midterm vote
results.content: While the Iranian regime says the US midterms will not change Washington's policy toward Tehran, some officials and commentators see the resounding Democratic victory as blowback against the Iran war.

results.title: What does Trump's midterm elections loss mean for strained US-India ties?
results.content: Donald Trump's electoral setback might give New Delhi and Washington space to reset relations, but there is no guarantee that the US will actually change its approach to India.

results.title: North Korea tells EU to 'mind its own business' on human rights
results.content: North Korea's UN mission has lashed out at the European Union over a draft UN resolution. Pyongyang has said the West does not have a monopoly on human rights.

results.title: Bomb threats disrupt several flights across Europe
results.content: At least a dozen flights were either diverted or landed with a military escort after bomb or security threats. The first reported case involved a flight from Dublin to Rome landing outside Paris and more soon followed.

results.title: South Korea tests Arctic shipping route amid Russia-West row
results.content: For South Korean ships, navigating off the north coast of Russia dramatically reduces travel time to Europe, but the pro-Ukraine coalition might see it as undermining their efforts to isolate Moscow.

results.title: What the Democrats' midterms win means for the US economy and Trump
results.content: From high oil prices and data centers to tariffs and mounting debt, economic concerns played a key role in the crushing defeat of President Donald Trump's Republicans. So can the Democrats now make a difference?

results.title: Winners, losers, the EU: Five takeaways from the US midterms
results.content: Donald Trump's Republicans suffered a crushing defeat in Tuesday's midterm elections, with the Democrats wresting control of Congress. What does this mean for US politics and the world?

results.title: 36 years later: Hungary opens Communist-era secret service files
results.content: Decades after the end of Soviet rule, Hungary is releasing all its secret service files. The disclosure is sparking fresh debate about informants, guilt and responsibility.

results.title: Kosovo: Outrage as authorities accused of not helping femicide victim
results.content: Despite reporting her husband to the police and pleading for protection, Arlinda Zekaj was brutally murdered. Now, thousands in Kosovo are protesting what they say is a dramatic failure of state institutions.
